stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Builder
stories.description: Implement query construction logic for ClinicalTrials.gov API including condition keywords, recruiting status filter, and location parameters based on validated inputs.

stories.title: Recruiting Filter and Result Parsing
stories.description: Parse ClinicalTrials.gov API response, enforce recruiting-only filtering, and extract structured trial data including identifiers, conditions, and site locations.

stories.title: Travel Distance Computation Integration
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each clinical trial site and attach results to trial records.

stories.title: External API Error Handling and Fallbacks
stories.description: Implement error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes failures including timeouts, partial data scenarios, and graceful degradation of distance metrics.
